hard_outcomes: The party explores substantially older and less controlled archive space.
The six current Face marks recur as an organizational framework: Might, Elements, Grace, Memory, Perception, Ruin.
Ruin is treated as structurally legitimate rather than corrupted or evil.
The party reaches the major Archive Scribe Engine at the threshold of the oldest accessible inner collections.

true_voice_requirements.nimera: Live brain; current Memory Face; high/frequent profanity with 15–35% long-form anti-sanitization calibration, self-correcting and engaged.
true_voice_requirements.torren: Concrete route/physical evidence, conversational freedom, no paternal behavior toward Nimera.
true_voice_requirements.ilyra: Dry curiosity and profanity available, no automatic safety narrator.
